description: I'm a student passionate about space exploration, coding, web development, and creative problem-solving. I'm building Afterlight, an interactive digital museum celebrating NASA's Spirit and Opportunity Mars rovers. I'm looking for curious, creative teammates interested in web development, UI/UX, graphic design, 3D modeling, animation, Mars science, research, and storytelling. All experience levels are welcome. Let's build something meaningful together!
summary: Afterlight is an interactive digital museum dedicated to NASA's Spirit and Opportunity Mars rovers, celebrating their missions, discoveries, and lasting contributions to planetary exploration. The project transforms the history of these two robotic explorers into an engaging digital experience through interactive rover profiles, mission case files, a chronological timeline, and visual storytelling. By bringing important moments from Mars exploration together in one accessible experience, Afterlight aims to make space science more engaging and understandable, especially for young learners and people interested in astronomy. It also highlights how robotic exploration helps us understand other worlds and inspires future generations to explore beyond Earth.
details:
Afterlight is an interactive digital museum that preserves and presents the missions of NASA's Spirit and Opportunity Mars rovers. It allows visitors to explore the two rovers through illustrative 3D models, rotate and zoom in on their structures, and select individual components to learn about their functions.

The experience also features an interactive mission timeline, rover comparisons, mission statistics, and cinematic visual storytelling that takes visitors from the solar system to the surface of Mars. Its source section connects visitors to NASA and Jet Propulsion Laboratory mission records, helping them explore the scientific history behind the missions.

The project aims to make planetary science more accessible and engaging, particularly for students and people interested in space exploration. It highlights the importance of robotic exploration and preserves the scientific legacy of two missions that greatly exceeded their original planned lifetimes.

Afterlight was developed as a browser-based web experience using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Three.js (WebGL) for 3D rendering. AI tools assisted with parts of the coding, development, and creative process.

Its design combines interactive learning, cinematic storytelling, and scientific information in a digital museum format. Accessibility, mobile responsiveness, reduced-motion preferences, scientific accuracy, and clear identification of illustrative models were considered during development.
